subject: DPA + subprocessors: Dedicated vs Private data flow and signing
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bluepoint.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Lopez <marco.lopez@bluepoint.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Bluepoint DPA redlines and deployment-specific questions

Hi Karthik / Stephanie,

Attached is Bluepoint's redline of Redwood's standard DPA (Bluepoint_DPA_Redline_v1.pdf). A few high-level requests up front so we can prioritize:

- Please confirm which subprocessors will process Customer Data when we run on Redwood Dedicated (hosted, reserved capacity) vs Redwood Private (VPC / on-prem).
- We need clarity on data egress and routing: where are logs, KV caches, and model telemetry stored for Dedicated vs Private.
- For Dedicated customers, we require either (i) documented SCCs + Data Transfer Addendum, or (ii) technical guarantees that EEA data never leaves region — which is your preference?
- Bluepoint wants DocuSign-ready DPA with redline accepted or clearly annotated counterproposal within 3 business days.

Please see inline comments on pages 4–6 (logging, backups, subprocessors) and a requested addendum for SOC 2 evidence. If you need a quick call to walk through the redlines, propose times tomorrow.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Legal Counsel, Bluepoint Analytics
elena.rossi@bluepoint.com
+44 20 7946 0123

Attachments: Bluepoint_DPA_Redline_v1.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bluepoint.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Bluepoint DPA redlines and deployment-specific questions

Elena — thanks for the redline and the clear list. Quick summary and proposed approach below; redline attached (Redwood_Response_DPA_redline.docx).

High-level answers:
- Subprocessors: For Redwood Dedicated (our hosted reserved capacity), processing is handled on dedicated tenancy in public cloud. Subprocessors will include our cloud infra providers (AWS/GCP depending on region), our managed logging provider, and a limited set of monitoring vendors. For Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem):
  - VPC deployment: customer-managed VPC with private peering; Redwood's control plane still runs in our cloud but we can scope telemetry to metadata-only. Certain managed services (billing, alerting) remain with our providers.
  - On-prem: Redwood ships a customer-run package; no cloud-hosted data plane access by Redwood; subprocessors are minimal (license portal, support tooling).

- Data residency and SCCs: We can offer SCCs + DTA for Dedicated. For EU-only residency we can pin Dedicated customers to EU region and restrict cross-region replication as part of the DPA addendum. For Private/VPC we can include stronger contractual guarantees and a limited set of subprocessors; for on-prem we accept the customer is fully responsible for data residency.

- Logs and telemetry: We propose a clause that for Dedicated we retain transient telemetry for performance debugging (rotated and retained for 30 days) and backups are encrypted and kept in-region by default. For VPC we do not collect raw request payloads — only metadata and aggregated metrics unless explicitly enabled. On-prem: no telemetry collected unless customer enables remote support channels.

Proposed next steps:
1) Please review the attached redline: we accepted a subset of your edits, flagged a few operational items for negotiation (Section 4 — logging, Section 7 — subprocessors list).
2) Stephanie will share a DocuSign envelope with the DPA + a Data Transfer Addendum option; we will attach our SCCs.
3) If Bluepoint needs an SOC 2 letter, Dylan will upload the latest attestation to a secure link once we have NDA alignment.

If it helps, I'm free 14:00–16:00 CET tomorrow for a short call.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Privacy & Legal Ops
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_Response_DPA_redline.docx
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bluepoint.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Lopez <marco.lopez@bluepoint.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2027 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Bluepoint DPA redlines and deployment-specific questions

Karthik / Stephanie — thanks for the quick reply and the redline. A few clarifying points from our side (inline but summarizing here):

- Section 4.2 (routing of logs): Bluepoint needs an assurance that "raw request payloads" will never be stored outside the EU for Dedicated customers. You mentioned in-region pinning — please confirm that backups and rotated logs are restricted to EU buckets. If you cannot guarantee this at the platform level, we will need an explicit exemption and corresponding additional safeguards.
- Subprocessors list: can you provide a definitive list for EU Dedicated nodes (AWS eu-west-1 / GCP europe-west1) and confirm whether any subcontractors in the US will ever have access to EU customer data?
- SOC 2: Bluepoint requests a copy of Redwood's current SOC 2 Type II report and date range. If that's not possible before signature, we expect a contract language commit to provide the report within 30 days of signature.

Also attached is a short doc with three SCCs-specific questions (SCCs-questions.docx) — mostly about the importer/exporter flow you propose in the DTA. We want to avoid broad "catch-all" language that permits transfers to unspecified subprocessors.

We aim to finalize within 3 business days. Can you confirm you will send an updated DPA with explicit EU subprocessors listed and a DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow?

Regards,
Elena Rossi
Legal Counsel, Bluepoint Analytics

Attachments: SCCs-questions.docx
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bluepoint.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2027 15:26:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Bluepoint DPA redlines and deployment-specific questions

Hi Elena — thanks, and apologies for the slight delay while we validated infra details with our infra team. Quick status and actions: 

- EU residency: confirmed — for Dedicated EU-region customers we will pin compute + backups to eu-west-1 (AWS) or europe-west1 (GCP) and we will not replicate logs outside the region unless explicitly requested and documented in the DPA addendum. We updated Section 4.2 to reflect that.
- Subprocessors: attached to the DocuSign envelope is the scoped subprocessor appendix for EU Dedicated which lists: AWS (eu-west-1 services used), Datadog (metrics only, EU-hosted), Sentry (error aggregation, EU-hosted), and our logging partner (EU instance). We have excluded US-based support access to raw request payloads for EU Dedicated customers.
- SOC 2: Dylan will provide a secure link to our latest SOC 2 Type II (period: 2026-06-01 to 2027-05-31) within 24 hours of signature per the commitment in the DPA.

DocuSign: signing envelope is ready. Link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/FAKE-EXAMPLE-URL-12345
Envelope contents: DPA (final redline accepted clauses), Data Transfer Addendum (SCCs attached), Subprocessor Appendix (EU Dedicated scope). Please review the DocuSign file list before signing.

Next steps:
- Elena / Bluepoint legal: confirm acceptance of the EU subprocessors appendix or propose one final narrow change.
- Karthik: follow up on the minor operational redlines around support access and telemetry retention (we agreed 30 days default retention unless otherwise requested).
- Dylan: share SOC 2 link after signature.

If Bluepoint is comfortable, we'll mark the deal as "redline-complete" on our side and proceed with signature. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you want to triage the SCC questions.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
